thread:
laura_people: Hey team — Im in Singapore and Feb 10 is a local public holiday here. I only have a floating holiday remaining and wanted to swap it to cover Feb 10. Is that allowed or do I need to take PTO?

ken_apac: Same question for our APAC folks. We often just use floating holidays but want to make sure payroll/processes are correct.

priya_hr: Short answer: you can use a floating holiday to cover a regional public holiday. Do a floating-holiday request in Workday and pick the APAC Observance option.

laura_people: If I submit the floating holiday, will the regional calendar still mark me as OOO automatically? Dont want duplicate blocks.

calendar_bot: Regional holiday events are added to personal calendars based on location set in your profile. If you submit a floating holiday for the same date, it will not duplicate the calendar entry but Workday will reflect the used floating day.

priya_hr: A few process notes:
- If your country has the public holiday as a statutory day off, you generally should not be charged PTO. Use the floating holiday only if you prefer.
- For payroll tax reporting, mark the location in Workday correctly (Country: SG).
- If youre out for a partial day, submit a half-day floating holiday.

laura_people: Im actually traveling back to the US that day for a customer visit. Which bucket should I use then? 

priya_hr: If youre physically not in the APAC region on that date and the US has a normal working day, use your PTO bucket (or unpaid) since the company wont treat it as a regional holiday for you. Make sure location reflects actual work location in Workday for that pay period.

emma_manager: For approvals: managers still need to approve floating holiday requests. If it's short notice, @laura_people please add a note with coverage or swap details. Approvals can be fast-tracked by tagging me.

laura_people: Thanks. One more: can I carryover an unused floating holiday into next fiscal year? I read something about carryover being limited.

priya_hr: Floating holiday carryover rules vary by hiring date and country. For APAC staff: up to 8 hours can carry over if request is made before payroll cutoff (Nov 30). Exceptions require the carryover-exception form.

laura_people: Great. Example Workday fields for anyone else:```Type: Floating Holiday
Date: 2027-02-10
Location: SG
Partial Day: No
Note: Covering local public holiday or: swap with PTO if traveling
```

tom_finance: FYI: if you swap between buckets after payroll cutoff we cant adjust retroactively without a manual payroll amendment. Best to finalize before Dec payroll close for year-end moves.

ken_apac: Noted. Ill remind the team to update locations for travel weeks. Thanks @priya_hr and @tom_finance.

laura_people: Filed the floating holiday request and added "traveling to US - will use PTO if needed" note. Approving manager notified. :airplane:
